instruction: Find and play the music video stored on the desktop using the VLC player.

files.path: /home/user/Desktop/Rick Astley - Never Gonna Give You Up (Official Music Video).mp4

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

rules.file_name: Rick Astley - Never Gonna Give You Up (Official Music Video).mp4

metadata.explanation: Task requires agent to find the music video file on desktop and initiate playback through VLC. Evaluator verifies VLC is in active playing state with the correct file loaded by querying VLC's HTTP status endpoint and parsing the XML response.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter (get_vlc_playing_info) correctly extracts VLC status by querying the HTTP status endpoint and saving the XML response
Metric (is_vlc_playing) correctly verifies both requirements: (1) VLC state is 'playing', (2) correct file is loaded
Metric uses robust file matching with multiple strategies: basename match, endswith match, and path contains match
Metric checks multiple XML paths to locate filename information, providing good fallback coverage
Expected value (filename) correctly matches the file downloaded in config setup
Complete coverage: evaluator verifies all instruction requirements (find + play the specific video file)
Runtime feasibility: VLC is launched with HTTP interface accessible, XML parsing is robust
